name: TC-01-authentication
description: TC-01: Authentication & User Management — Login, profile, and user CRUD validation

doc_metadata.title: TC-01 — Clear Session
doc_metadata.caption: Clear browser cookies and local storage to ensure a clean test state.

doc_metadata.title: TC-01.1 — Login Page
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to the login page. The login form displays with Username and Password fields, along with the organization branding (logo and name).
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Opening screenshot for the Authentication chapter.

doc_metadata.title: TC-01.1 — Successful Login
doc_metadata.caption: After entering valid credentials and clicking 'Sign In', you are redirected to the Home page. The sidebar displays navigation items based on your role permissions.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the home page after successful login with sidebar visible.

doc_metadata.title: TC-01.1 — Sidebar & Navigation
doc_metadata.caption: The sidebar shows all available modules based on your role. Admin users can see all entities including Settings, Admin, Workflow, and Model Editor sections.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Annotate the sidebar sections: Navigation, Modules, Admin.

doc_metadata.title: TC-01.5 — User Menu
doc_metadata.caption: Click your name/avatar at the bottom of the sidebar to open the user menu. From here you can access your Profile or Logout.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the user dropdown with Profile and Logout options.
